errors.text_span: Очакваните стойности на оста X са 2012 и 2019.
errors.evidence: The phrase 'Очакваните стойности' (Expected values) is awkward and unclear. A better phrasing would be to state the range, for example, 'диапазонът на стойностите е от 2012 до 2019' (the range of values is from 2012 to 2019).
The Y-axis labels clearly show a range from 0 to 30000.

errors.text_span: Значенията на оста Y са равномерно разпределени на интервали от 1000 евро.
errors.evidence: The labeled tick marks on the Y-axis (0, 5000, 10000, etc.) are at intervals of 5000, not 1000.
The line in 2012 starts at a value just below the 20000 gridline, approximately at 19,500. The reported value of 17,500 is significantly lower.
The line in 2019 ends at a value just above the 25000 gridline, approximately at 26,000. The reported value of 27,000 is significantly higher.

errors.text_span: стойността се покачва от приблизително 17500 през 2012 до 27000 през 2019.
errors.evidence: This clause unnecessarily repeats the starting and ending values that were stated in the preceding clause of the same sentence.
The description omits that the GDP per capita is 'в съответствие с ППС' (according to PPP), which is specified in the figure caption.
